name: integral-productivity-engineering
description: Engineering practice for Integral Productivity, covering the life of a repo and the life of a unit of work. Cold-start: routes new repos to the right work-type template + scaffolding skill and verifies they classify under devops-excellence's tier/work-type model, delegating in-plugin to bootstrap-mcp-server and bootstrap-private-sdk. Work intake: issue-triage assigns state, category, and the GlassFrog role accountable for an issue (per SAE-009), and writing-dispatch-prompts defines the contract for handing that work to another agent session. Companion to the `devops-excellence` repo's bootstrap CLI and `template-*` repos.
